publication.title: Studying Interaction Patterns for Knowledge Graph Exploration

source_reading.scope: Located primary-source extraction; integral-reading coverage was not stored in this profile.

adjudication.basis: The report describes user-facing exploration or query interaction over RDF, Linked Data or knowledge-graph data. See the source locators for the implemented method and evaluation.

backend.source_model_description: Prototype extending sequential question answering over a medical KG

studies.response_note: {"n": 8, "first_stage_n": 3, "second_stage_n": 5, "background": "Final-year medical students at University of Basel"}
tasks: Initial diagnosis from the same fictional patient case; second stage used additional orientation/navigation features
comparators: Before/after design stages with new participants; relative preferences among clustering, node weighting, reduction slider, textual and visual guidance
measures: Video/MAXQDA coding, feature-use frequencies, observations and follow-up interviews
studies.results: Second-stage users preferred clustering for orientation; textual vs visual navigation preference varied by user, and no superiority of either navigation mode was established
limitations: Different first/second-stage participants are reported; same prototype, not independent system comparisons. Cross-report relation to2021participants remains unknown.
